### sgg(merged) shapefile
```{r}
# 1) 읽기
sgg <- st_read("sgis_sgg_merged/SGG_merged.gpkg", quiet = TRUE)

# 2) 좌표계: 라벨 없으면 set_crs, 있으면 transform (5186 고정)
crs_now <- st_crs(sgg)
if (is.na(crs_now)) {
  sgg <- st_set_crs(sgg, 5186)
} else if (is.na(crs_now$epsg) || crs_now$epsg != 5186) {
  sgg <- st_transform(sgg, 5186)
}
sgg <- st_make_valid(sgg)

sgg <- sgg %>%
  mutate(new_sigungu_cd = as.character(new_sigungu_cd)) %>%
  filter(new_sigungu_cd %in% unique(dt_q$sgg_code_sgis)) %>%
  arrange(new_sigungu_cd) %>%
  mutate(idx = row_number())
```

### covariates list
```{r}
## 0) 공변량 리스트 한 번만 정의
covariates <- c(
  "sex_ratio_z",
  "pop_65plus_z",
  "trade_balance_z",
  "mei_z",
  # "mig_inter_sido_out_z",
  "grdp_1st_dev_z",
  "grdp_2nd_dev_z",
  # "grdp_3rd_dev_z",
  "gdp_curr_gdp_total_z",
  # "ind_ratio_manufacturing_z",
  "ind_ratio_construction_z",
  "ind_ratio_wholesale_retail_z",
  # "ind_ratio_business_z",
  "lf_unemployment_rate_z",
  # "lf_employment_rate_z",
  "lf_employment_rate_15_64_z",
  "dummy_covid",
  "dummy_capital",
  "dummy_si",
  "dummy_gu",
  "indpark_dummy",
  "indpark_area_mgmt_z"
)

covariate_terms <- paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")

## 1) 여러 formula에 공변량을 붙이는 함수
add_covariates <- function(base_form) {
  update(base_form, as.formula(paste(". ~ . +", covariate_terms)))
}
```


```{r}
# 필요한 패키지 로드
library(corrplot)
library(dplyr)

# 1. 분석 대상 공변량만 추출
# data.table인 경우: df_subset <- dt_y[, ..covariates]
# data.frame인 경우: df_subset <- dt_y[, covariates]
df_subset <- dt_y %>% select(all_of(covariates))

# 2. 상관계수 계산 (결측치 제외)
cor_mat <- cor(df_subset, use = "complete.obs")

# 3. 시각화 (숫자와 색상으로 표현)
# tl.cex: 텍스트 크기, tl.col: 텍스트 색상
corrplot(cor_mat, 
         method = "color", 
         type = "upper", 
         order = "hclust", 
         addCoef.col = "black", # 상관계수 수치 표시
         tl.col = "black", 
         tl.srt = 45,
         number.cex = 0.7,
         diag = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# 1. 임시 종속변수 생성 (VIF는 X끼리의 관계만 보므로 Y는 아무 값이나 상관없음)
# 실제 종속변수가 있다면 그것을 써도 되지만, 공선성 체크용으로는 난수도 무방함
# dt_y$e9 <- rnorm(nrow(dt_y))

# 2. 회귀식(Formula) 만들기
f <- as.formula(paste("e9 ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")))

# 3. 선형 회귀모형 적합
vif_model <- lm(f, data = dt_y)

# 4. VIF 계산
vif_values <- car::vif(vif_model)

# 5. 보기 좋게 정리 (VIF가 높은 순서대로 정렬)
vif_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(vif_values), 
  VIF = vif_values
)
vif_df <- vif_df[order(vif_df$VIF, decreasing = TRUE), ]

print(vif_df)

fwrite(vif_df, file = "vif_dt_y.csv")
```

## summary
```{r}
library(data.table)

# 1) _z 떼서 raw 변수명 만들기
raw_vars <- sub("_z$", "", covariates)

# 2) 실제 존재하는 컬럼만
raw_vars <- raw_vars[raw_vars %in% names(dt_y)]

# (선택) raw 변수가 없는 애들 확인
missing_raw <- setdiff(sub("_z$", "", covariates), names(dt_y))
if (length(missing_raw) > 0) print(missing_raw)

# 3) 변수별 요약통계(안전하게 1행씩 생성)
raw_stats_long <- rbindlist(lapply(raw_vars, function(v) {
  x <- dt_y[[v]]

  # 숫자 아니면 숫자로 변환 시도 (factor/character 대비)
  if (!is.numeric(x)) x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

  data.table(
    variable = v,
    n    = sum(!is.na(x)),
    mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    min  = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    p50  = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    max  = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}), fill = TRUE)

# 4) 정렬 + 확인
# setorder(raw_stats_long, variable)
raw_stats_long

fwrite(raw_stats_long, file = "raw_covariates_summary_y.csv")
```

### AR1_null

```{r}
form_ar1_y <- e9 ~ 1 +
  f(time_id_year, model="ar1",
    hyper = list(
      theta1 = list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(1, 0.01)),
      rho  = list(prior="pc.cor1", param=c(0.7, 0.5))     # AR(1) 상관 PC prior
    )
  )

fit_ar1_y <- inla(
  formula = form_ar1_y,
  data    = dt_y,
  family  = "poisson",
  E       = dt_y$total_emp,   # ★ 인구를 기대노출로
  control.compute   = list(dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE),
  control.predictor = list(link=1, compute=TRUE),
  control.inla      = list(strategy="simplified.laplace",
                           control.vb=list(emergency=50))
)

summary(fit_ar1_y)
fit_ar1_y$waic$waic; fit_ar1_y$dic$dic
```

### BYM2 + AR

```{r}
# BYM2: 공간, 그래프=G
# AR(1): 시간
form_bym2_ar1 <- e9 ~ 1 +
  f(space_id, model="bym2", graph=G,
    scale.model=TRUE,
    hyper = list(
      prec = list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(1, 0.01)),     # precision PC prior
      phi  = list(prior="pc", param=c(0.5, 0.5))          # mixing parameter prior
    )
  ) +
  f(time_id_year, model="ar1",
    hyper = list(
      prec = list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(1, 0.01)),
      rho  = list(prior="pc.cor1", param=c(0.7, 0.5))     # AR(1) 상관 PC prior
    )
  )

fit_bym2_ar1 <- inla(
  formula = form_bym2_ar1,
  data    = dt_y,
  family  = "poisson",
  E       = dt_y$total_emp2,
  control.compute   = list(dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE),
  control.predictor = list(link=1, compute=TRUE),
  control.inla      = list(
    strategy   = "adaptive",     # <- simplified.laplace 대신
    diagonal   = 1e-5,           # <- 수치적 안정화(정규화)
    control.vb = list(emergency=200)
  ),
  control.mode = list(restart=TRUE),  # 초기값 재시작
  verbose = TRUE
)

summary(fit_bym2_ar1)
fit_bym2_ar1$waic$waic; fit_bym2_ar1$dic$dic

```

### BYM2 \* AR (time-varying spatial random effects)

```{r}
# 공간 ID를 시간별로 복제한 인덱스(상호작용용)
# dt_y <- dt_y %>% arrange(time_id_year, space_id)
# dt_y$space_id_st <- dt_y$space_id          # 동일 값이지만 group=time_id_year로 복제될 것

form_interaction_y <- e9 ~ 1 +
  # 메인 공간효과(선택): 때로는 제거하고 상호작용만 두기도 함
  f(space_id, model="bym2", graph=G, scale.model=TRUE,
    hyper = list(
      prec = list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(1, 0.01)),
      phi  = list(prior="pc", param=c(0.5, 0.5))
    )) +
  # 메인 시간효과
  f(time_id_year, model="ar1",
    hyper = list(
      theta1 = list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(1, 0.01)),
      rho  = list(prior="pc.cor1", param=c(0.7, 0.5))
    )) +
  # 공간×시간 상호작용: BYM2를 시간별 복제, 시간 간 AR(1)로 연결
  f(space_id_st, model="bym2", graph=G, scale.model=TRUE,
    group = time_id_year,
    control.group = list(model="ar1",
                         hyper = list(
                           theta1 = list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(1, 0.01)),
                           rho  = list(prior="pc.cor1", param=c(0.7, 0.5))
                         )),
    hyper = list(
      prec = list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(1, 0.01)),
      phi  = list(prior="pc", param=c(0.5, 0.5))
    )
  )

fit_interaction_y <- inla(
  formula = form_interaction_y,
  data    = dt_y,
  family  = "poisson",
  E       = dt_y$total_emp,   # ★ 인구를 기대노출로
  control.compute   = list(dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE),
  control.predictor = list(link=1, compute=TRUE),
  control.inla      = list(strategy="simplified.laplace",
                           control.vb=list(emergency=50))
)

summary(fit_interaction_y)
fit_interaction_y$waic$waic; fit_interaction_y$dic$dic

```

```{r}
## 1) WAIC, DIC 뽑아서 data.frame으로 만드는 헬퍼
extract_criteria <- function(fit_list) {
  data.frame(
    model = names(fit_list),
    WAIC  = sapply(fit_list, function(x) x$waic$waic),
    DIC   = sapply(fit_list, function(x) x$dic$dic),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

## 사용
crit_y <- extract_criteria(fits_y)
crit_y
write.csv(crit_y, "comparison_y.csv", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "euc-kr")
```

## save results

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
  library(forcats)
  library(readr)
  library(sf)
  library(spdep)
  library(Matrix)
  library(INLA)
  library(rlang)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(scales)
})

# ----------------------------
# 0) 출력 폴더
# ----------------------------
out_dir <- "outputs/inla_results_y_e9"
fig_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "_fig")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

saveRDS(fit_cov_y, file.path(out_dir, "fit_cov_y.rds"))

# ----------------------------
# 1) 지도 함수 (단일 시점)
#    - midpoint 주면 gradient2 사용 (잔차/로그효과용)
# ----------------------------
plot_sgg_var <- function(dt,
                         sgg,
                         var,
                         time_value = NULL,
                         low  = "grey95",
                         high = "steelblue",
                         midpoint = NULL,
                         fill_label = NULL,
                         base_size = 14,
                         width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300,
                         fig_dir = "_fig") {

  var_yuo <- rlang::enquo(var)

  if (is.null(time_value)) {
    time_value <- dt %>% summarise(last = max(yyyymm, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% pull(last)
  }

  dt_time <- dt %>% dplyr::filter(yyyymm == time_value)

  sgg_map <- sgg %>%
    dplyr::left_join(dt_time, by = c("idx" = "space_id"))

  if (is.null(fill_label)) fill_label <- rlang::as_name(var_yuo)

  p <- ggplot(sgg_map) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = !!var_yuo), color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.1) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(fill_label, " (yyyymm = ", time_value, ")"),
      fill  = fill_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  if (is.null(midpoint)) {
    p <- p + scale_fill_gradient(low = low, high = high)
  } else {
    p <- p + scale_fill_gradient2(low = low, high = high, midpoint = midpoint)
  }

  file_stem <- paste0(fill_label, "_", time_value)
  file_stem_safe <- gsub("[^[:alnum:]가-힣]+", "_", file_stem)
  file_name <- file.path(fig_dir, paste0(file_stem_safe, ".png"))

  ggsave(filename = file_name, plot = p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  message("Saved plot to: ", file_name)
  p
}

# ----------------------------
# 2) Sanity checks
# ----------------------------
stopifnot(is.numeric(dt_y$yyyymm))
stopifnot(all(dt_y$total_emp > 0, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot(nrow(dt_y) == nrow(fit_cov_y$summary.fitted.values))

stopifnot(all(c("space_id","time_id_year","yyyymm","total_emp") %in% names(dt_y)))
stopifnot("idx" %in% names(sgg))

# time_id_year <-> yyyymm
time_map <- dt_y %>% distinct(time_id_year, yyyymm) %>% arrange(time_id_year)
dup_time <- time_map %>% count(time_id_year) %>% filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(dup_time) > 0) warning("time_id_year가 yyyymm에 1:1로 매핑되지 않습니다. time_map 확인 필요")

# 공간 인덱스 정합 체크(강하게)
N_map <- nrow(sgg)
if (max(dt_y$space_id, na.rm=TRUE) != N_map) {
  warning("space_id 최대값(", max(dt_y$space_id, na.rm=TRUE), ") != nrow(sgg)(", N_map, "). ",
          "sgg$idx == space_id 정합을 확인하세요.")
}

# ----------------------------
# 3) 고정효과 저장 (IRR)
# ----------------------------
fixed_df <- fit_cov_y$summary.fixed %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    irr_mean = exp(mean),
    irr_lo   = exp(`0.025quant`),
    irr_hi   = exp(`0.975quant`)
  ) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    sig_95 = if_else(irr_lo > 1 | irr_hi < 1, "95% CrI excludes 1", "Includes 1"),
    term   = fct_reorder(term, irr_mean)
  )

write_csv(fixed_df, file.path(out_dir, "fixed_effects.csv"))

p_fix <- ggplot(fixed_df, aes(x = irr_mean, y = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = irr_lo, xmax = irr_hi, color = sig_95),
                 height = 0.25, linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig_95, shape = sig_95), size = 4) +
  labs(x="IRR = exp(beta)", y=NULL, color=NULL, shape=NULL,
       title="Fixed effects (IRR, 95% CrI)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 26) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size=30, face="bold", hjust=0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size=26, margin=margin(t=10)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size=20),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size=22),
    legend.text  = element_text(size=20),
    legend.position="bottom",
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fixed_effects_forest.png"), p_fix, width=10, height=9, dpi=300)

# ----------------------------
# 4) 하이퍼파라미터 저장
# ----------------------------
if (!is.null(fit_cov_y$summary.hyperpar)) {
  hyper_df <- fit_cov_y$summary.hyperpar %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("hyper") %>%
    as_tibble()
  write_csv(hyper_df, file.path(out_dir, "hyperparameters.csv"))
}

# ----------------------------
# 5) 랜덤효과 저장 helpers
# ----------------------------
extract_random <- function(fit, re_name) {
  df <- fit$summary.random[[re_name]]
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  df <- as.data.frame(df) %>% as_tibble()
  if (!("ID" %in% names(df))) names(df)[1] <- "ID"
  df %>% mutate(
    effect = re_name,
    mult_mean = exp(mean),
    mult_lo   = exp(`0.025quant`),
    mult_hi   = exp(`0.975quant`)
  )
}

re_space <- extract_random(fit_cov_y, "space_id")
re_time  <- extract_random(fit_cov_y, "time_id_year")
re_st    <- extract_random(fit_cov_y, "space_id_st")

if (!is.null(re_space)) write_csv(re_space, file.path(out_dir, "random_space_id.csv"))
if (!is.null(re_time))  write_csv(re_time,  file.path(out_dir, "random_time_id_year.csv"))
if (!is.null(re_st))    write_csv(re_st,    file.path(out_dir, "random_space_id_st_raw.csv"))

# time effect + yyyymm
if (!is.null(re_time)) {
  re_time2 <- re_time %>%
    mutate(time_id_year = as.integer(ID)) %>%
    left_join(time_map, by="time_id_year") %>%
    arrange(time_id_year)
  write_csv(re_time2, file.path(out_dir, "random_time_id_year_with_yyyymm.csv"))

  p_time <- ggplot(re_time2, aes(x=yyyymm, y=mult_mean)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=mult_lo, ymax=mult_hi), alpha=0.2) +
    geom_line() + geom_point(size=1) +
    labs(x=NULL, y="exp(eta_t) (multiplier)", title="Common time trend (AR1)") +
    theme_bw()
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "random_time_trend.png"), p_time, width=7, height=4, dpi=300)
}

# ----------------------------
# 6) 예측치 저장 (너 결과 기준: fitted.values = rate/lambda)
#    - lambda = fitted.values
#    - mu     = E * lambda
#    + 잔차 (Poisson 기준)
# ----------------------------

fv <- fit_cov_y$summary.fitted.values

# ★ fit 직전과 같은 정렬로 맞춤 (매우 중요)
dt_y_fit <- dt_y %>% arrange(time_id_year, space_id)
stopifnot(nrow(dt_y_fit) == nrow(fv))

dt_pred <- dt_y_fit %>%
  mutate(
    # 1) rate (lambda / IR / relative risk)
    ir_hat = fv$mean,
    ir_lo  = fv$`0.025quant`,
    ir_hi  = fv$`0.975quant`,
    ir_width = ir_hi - ir_lo,

    # 2) expected count (mu) = E * rate
    mu_mean = total_emp * ir_hat,
    mu_lo   = total_emp * ir_lo,
    mu_hi   = total_emp * ir_hi
  )

# ---- 잔차 (Poisson) ----
eps <- 1e-12
y  <- dt_pred$e9
mu <- pmax(dt_pred$mu_mean, eps)

dt_pred <- dt_pred %>%
  mutate(
    resid_pearson = (y - mu) / sqrt(mu),
    resid_dev = {
      y0 <- pmax(y, 0)
      term <- ifelse(y0 == 0, 0, y0 * log((y0 + eps) / mu))
      sign(y0 - mu) * sqrt(pmax(2 * (term - (y0 - mu)), 0))
    }
  )

# ★ sanity check: 이제 y/mu ~ 1 근처가 나와야 정상
print(summary(dt_pred$e9 / pmax(dt_pred$mu_mean, 1e-12)))
print(cor(dt_pred$e9, dt_pred$mu_mean, use="complete.obs"))

# ----------------------------
# 6-1) u_it 복원: space_id_st가 (2*NT)로 나온 BYM2 블록 케이스 처리
#   - group 컬럼이 있으면 그걸로 조인
#   - group 없고 nrow(re_st)==2*(N*T)이면 structured/iid 결합해서 u_log_mean 생성
# ----------------------------
re_st2 <- NULL

if (!is.null(re_st)) {
  N <- dplyr::n_distinct(dt_y$space_id)
  T <- dplyr::n_distinct(dt_y$time_id_year)
  NT <- N * T

  if ("group" %in% names(re_st)) {
    re_st2 <- re_st %>%
      mutate(space_id = as.integer(ID),
             time_id_year  = as.integer(group)) %>%
      left_join(time_map, by="time_id_year") %>%
      transmute(space_id, time_id_year, yyyymm,
                u_log = mean,
                u_mult = exp(mean),
                u_lo = exp(`0.025quant`),
                u_hi = exp(`0.975quant`))
  } else {
    # group이 없는 케이스: BYM2가 2블록으로 붙어나온 경우가 흔함
    if (nrow(re_st) == 2 * NT) {
      hp <- fit_cov_y$summary.hyperpar
      pick_hp <- function(pattern, col="0.5quant") {
        rn <- rownames(hp)
        i <- grep(pattern, rn, ignore.case=TRUE)
        if (length(i)==0) stop("hyperpar에서 ", pattern, " 찾지 못함")
        as.numeric(hp[i[1], col])
      }

      prec_st <- pick_hp("^Precision for space_id_st", "0.5quant")
      phi_st  <- pick_hp("^Phi for space_id_st", "0.5quant")

      u_struct <- re_st$mean[1:NT]
      u_iid    <- re_st$mean[(NT+1):(2*NT)]

      # BYM2 결합(근사; mean만 복원)
      u_log_mean <- (sqrt(phi_st) * u_struct + sqrt(1 - phi_st) * u_iid) / sqrt(prec_st)

      grid_st <- tidyr::expand_grid(
        time_id_year  = sort(unique(dt_y$time_id_year)),
        space_id = sort(unique(dt_y$space_id))
      ) %>%
        arrange(time_id_year, space_id) %>%
        mutate(
          u_log  = u_log_mean,
          u_mult = exp(u_log)
        ) %>%
        left_join(time_map, by="time_id_year") %>%
        select(space_id, time_id_year, yyyymm, u_log, u_mult)

      re_st2 <- grid_st
    } else {
      message("space_id_st에 group 없음 & nrow가 2*NT도 아님 -> u_it 복원 스킵. ",
              "(nrow(re_st)=", nrow(re_st), ", NT=", NT, ")")
    }
  }
}

if (!is.null(re_st2)) {
  write_csv(re_st2, file.path(out_dir, "random_space_time_u_it_with_yyyymm.csv"))
  dt_pred <- dt_pred %>%
    left_join(re_st2, by=c("space_id","time_id_year","yyyymm"))
}

write.csv(dt_pred, file.path(out_dir, "dt_pred_with_mu_ir_resid_random_effects.csv"), fileEncoding = "euc-kr")

# ----------------------------
# 7) G 기반 nb/listw 만들기 (Moran용)
# ----------------------------
make_nb_from_inla_graph <- function(G) {
  W <- INLA:::inla.graph2matrix(G)
  W <- (W + Matrix::t(W)) > 0
  diag(W) <- 0
  W <- Matrix::Matrix(W * 1, sparse = TRUE)

  nb <- spdep::mat2listw(as.matrix(W), style="B", zero.policy=TRUE)$neighbours
  nb <- spdep::make.sym.nb(nb)
  nb
}

nb_G <- make_nb_from_inla_graph(G)

# ----------------------------
# 8) 분기별 Moran's I (subset.listw 안 씀: subset.nb로 해결)
# ----------------------------
moran_by_time_nb <- function(dt_pred,
                             nb,
                             times = NULL,
                             var_col = "resid_pearson",
                             space_col = "space_id",
                             time_col  = "yyyymm",
                             style = "W",
                             zero.policy = TRUE,
                             method = c("analytic","mc"),
                             nsim = 999) {

  method <- match.arg(method)
  stopifnot(var_col %in% names(dt_pred))
  N <- length(nb)

  if (is.null(times)) times <- sort(unique(dt_pred[[time_col]]))
  times <- sort(unique(times))

  moran_one <- function(tv) {
    tmp <- dt_pred %>%
      filter(.data[[time_col]] == tv) %>%
      select(space_id = all_of(space_col), x = all_of(var_col)) %>%
      distinct(space_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

    if (any(tmp$space_id < 1 | tmp$space_id > N, na.rm=TRUE)) {
      stop("space_id가 nb 노드 범위(1..N) 밖입니다. 정합 확인 필요.")
    }

    x_full <- rep(NA_real_, N)
    x_full[tmp$space_id] <- tmp$x

    valid <- !is.na(x_full)
    n_valid <- sum(valid)

    if (n_valid < 3) {
      return(tibble(yyyymm=tv, n=n_valid, I=NA_real_, z=NA_real_, p=NA_real_))
    }

    nb_sub <- spdep::subset.nb(nb, subset = valid)
    lw_sub <- spdep::nb2listw(nb_sub, style=style, zero.policy=zero.policy)
    x_sub  <- x_full[valid]

    if (method == "analytic") {
      mt <- spdep::moran.test(x_sub, lw_sub, zero.policy=zero.policy)
      tibble(
        yyyymm = tv,
        n      = n_valid,
        I      = unname(mt$estimate[["Moran I statistic"]]),
        z      = unname(mt$statistic),
        p      = unname(mt$p.value)
      )
    } else {
      mc <- spdep::moran.mc(x_sub, lw_sub, nsim=nsim, zero.policy=zero.policy)
      tibble(
        yyyymm = tv,
        n      = n_valid,
        I      = unname(mc$statistic),
        z      = NA_real_,
        p      = unname(mc$p.value)
      )
    }
  }

  bind_rows(lapply(times, moran_one)) %>% arrange(yyyymm)
}

moran_res <- moran_by_time_nb(
  dt_pred = dt_pred,
  nb      = nb_G,
  times   = sort(unique(dt_pred$yyyymm)),
  var_col = "resid_pearson",
  style   = "W",
  method  = "analytic"
)

write_csv(moran_res, file.path(out_dir, "moran_resid_pearson_by_time.csv"))

p_moran <- ggplot(moran_res, aes(x=yyyymm, y=I)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(shape = p < 0.05), size=2.5) +
  labs(title="Moran's I of Pearson residuals by time", x=NULL, y="Moran's I", shape="p < 0.05") +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "moran_resid_pearson_by_time.png"), p_moran, width=8, height=4, dpi=300)

# ----------------------------
# 9) u_it 여러 시점 1x3 슬라이스 (facet)
# ----------------------------
plot_u_it_slices <- function(dt_pred, sgg,
                             times,
                             var = c("u_log","u_mult"),
                             nrow = 1, ncol = 3,
                             quant_clip = 0.02,
                             base_size = 13,
                             save_path = NULL,
                             width = 15, height = 5, dpi = 300) {

  var <- match.arg(var)
  stopifnot(var %in% names(dt_pred))
  stopifnot(all(c("space_id","yyyymm") %in% names(dt_pred)))
  stopifnot("idx" %in% names(sgg))

  times <- sort(unique(times))
  times <- times[seq_len(min(length(times), nrow*ncol))]

  sl <- dt_pred %>%
    filter(yyyymm %in% times) %>%
    select(space_id, yyyymm, value = all_of(var)) %>%
    mutate(yyyymm = factor(yyyymm, levels = times)) %>%
    distinct(space_id, yyyymm, .keep_all = TRUE)

  sgg_map <- sgg %>% left_join(sl, by=c("idx"="space_id"))

  vv <- sgg_map$value
  vv <- vv[is.finite(vv)]
  if (length(vv)==0) stop("u_it 붙었는지 확인.")

  lo <- as.numeric(quantile(vv, probs=quant_clip, na.rm=TRUE))
  hi <- as.numeric(quantile(vv, probs=1-quant_clip, na.rm=TRUE))
  mid <- if (var=="u_log") 0 else 1

  p <- ggplot(sgg_map) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill=value), color="grey70", linewidth=0.1) +
    facet_wrap(~ yyyymm, nrow=nrow, ncol=ncol) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(midpoint=mid, limits=c(lo,hi), oob=scales::squish) +
    labs(
      title = if (var=="u_log") "u_it (log-scale)" else "exp(u_it) (multiplier)",
      fill = var
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=base_size) +
    theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5),
          strip.text=element_text(face="bold"),
          legend.title=element_text(face="bold"))

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    ggsave(save_path, p, width=width, height=height, dpi=dpi)
    message("Saved: ", save_path)
  }
  p
}

# ----------------------------
# 10) 지도 출력 (마지막 시점 + 잔차 + (있으면) u_it)
# ----------------------------
target_times <- sort(unique(dt_pred$yyyymm))
target_times <- tail(target_times, 1)

for (tv in target_times) {
  plot_sgg_var(dt_pred, sgg, ir_hat,  tv, fill_label="Predicted IR",
               low="grey95", high="steelblue", fig_dir=fig_dir)

  plot_sgg_var(dt_pred, sgg, mu_mean, tv, fill_label="Predicted Count (mu)",
               low="grey95", high="steelblue", fig_dir=fig_dir)

  plot_sgg_var(dt_pred, sgg, ir_width, tv, fill_label="IR 95% CrI width",
               low="grey95", high="steelblue", fig_dir=fig_dir)

  plot_sgg_var(dt_pred, sgg, resid_pearson, tv, fill_label="Pearson residual",
               low="grey95", high="steelblue", midpoint=0, fig_dir=fig_dir)

  plot_sgg_var(dt_pred, sgg, resid_dev, tv, fill_label="Deviance residual",
               low="grey95", high="steelblue", midpoint=0, fig_dir=fig_dir)

  if ("s_mult" %in% names(dt_pred)) {
    plot_sgg_var(dt_pred, sgg, s_mult, tv, fill_label="Spatial main effect exp(s_i)",
                 low="grey95", high="steelblue", fig_dir=fig_dir)
  }

  if ("u_log" %in% names(dt_pred)) {
    plot_sgg_var(dt_pred, sgg, u_log, tv, fill_label="Space-time interaction u_it (log)",
                 low="grey95", high="steelblue", midpoint=0, fig_dir=fig_dir)
  }
}

# u_it 1x3 슬라이스 
if ("u_mult" %in% names(dt_pred)) {
  times3 <- tail(sort(unique(dt_pred$yyyymm)), 3)
  p_u3 <- plot_u_it_slices(
    dt_pred, sgg, times=times3, var="u_mult", nrow=1, ncol=3,
    save_path = file.path(fig_dir, paste0("u_it_slices_1x3_u_mult_", paste(times3, collapse="_"), ".png")),
    width=15, height=5, dpi=300
  )
  print(p_u3)
}

message("All outputs saved under: ", normalizePath(out_dir))
```
